s51/ribbon_haolamim.primary: Lord of all worlds! Not on account of our righteousness do we lay our supplications before Thee but because of Thy great compassion. What are we, what is our life, what is our grace, what is our righteousness, what is our aid, what is our power, what is our strength. What shall we speak before Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, truly all heroes are as nothing before Thee, famous men as though they had never existed, wise men as though without understanding and intelligent people as though without sense; for the amount of their work is vain and the days of their lives are empty before Thee, and the superiority of man over the animal is nought for everything is vain.
